definitions.gloss: day and night, around the clock
definitions.explanation: Daytime and nighttime together, often implying continuous activity without rest. Used to emphasize that something goes on without stopping.

examples.japanese: {昼夜|ちゅうや}を{問|と}わず{働|はたら}く。
examples.english: To work regardless of day or night.

examples.japanese: {工場|こうじょう}は{昼夜|ちゅうや}{交代|こうたい}で{稼働|かどう}している。
examples.english: The factory operates in day and night shifts.

examples.japanese: {被災地|ひさいち}では{救助|きゅうじょ}{隊|たい}が{昼夜|ちゅうや}を{問|と}わず{捜索|そうさく}{活動|かつどう}を{続|つづ}けている。
examples.english: In the disaster-stricken area, rescue teams continue search operations around the clock.

notes:
USAGE:
Often used in the set phrase {昼夜|ちゅうや}を{問|と}わず (regardless of day or night). Also used as a modifier: {昼夜|ちゅうや}{交代|こうたい} (day-night shift rotation), {昼夜|ちゅうや}{逆転|ぎゃくてん} (reversed sleep schedule). A formal word; in casual speech, {朝|あさ}から{晩|ばん}まで is more common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {昼夜|ちゅうや}を{問|と}わず: regardless of day or night
- {昼夜|ちゅうや}{交代|こうたい}: day-night shift
- {昼夜|ちゅうや}{逆転|ぎゃくてん}: reversed day-night cycle
- {昼夜|ちゅうや}{兼行|けんこう}: marching day and night

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {日夜|にちや}: day and night (similar, slightly more common)
- {終日|しゅうじつ}: all day long
